name: relative_campaign_owner
economic_hypothesis: A funded campaign that remains positive and beats the frozen CSI 300 at both its fifth and tenth owned-session reviews is a compoundable ownership state; after maturity this state should replace generic slow-trend exit decisions without changing opportunity ranking, capacity or funding.

treatment.campaign_origin: first actual funded open after a flat inventory state
treatment.quality_at_full_review: stock excess log return over benchmark is positive at owned sessions 5 and 10, and stock absolute return from the actual campaign opening session is positive at session 10
treatment.mature_ownership: after session 10, a quality campaign ignores the generic slow-trend exit while cumulative absolute and benchmark-relative return from the actual opening session remain positive; loss of either condition closes the campaign
treatment.discovery_ownership: before session 10, unchanged price-book exits remain authoritative
always_authoritative: single-session loss of at least 8 percent
next-session execution, limit, capacity, board-lot, fee and cash constraints

fixed_screen.pass: treatment wealth is no lower than paired control in every scope and strictly higher in at least one scope
fixed_screen.failure: any scope wealth regression rejects the candidate; do not search review windows, benchmark, sign thresholds, confirmation days, hold fractions or capacity

prohibitions: no new entry gate or cash sleeve
